stages.title: Foundations
stages.milestone: Write small programs with correct types and no unnecessary any.

stages.title: Core Programming
stages.milestone: Model application data and build reusable, type-safe functions.

stages.title: Advanced Language Features
stages.milestone: Structure a multi-file TypeScript application and understand its build configuration.

stages.title: Runtime and Integration
stages.milestone: Integrate an external API and handle untrusted data safely.

stages.title: Professional Engineering
stages.milestone: Build and test an application with documented types, dependable error handling and repeatable builds.

stages.title: Project-Based Mastery
stages.milestone: Complete, test, document and present a capstone application.

dependency_map.from: JavaScript syntax, values, functions, arrays and objects
dependency_map.to: Core TypeScript annotations, narrowing, interfaces and generics
Async programming, API contracts and project references
Runtime validation, typed API clients and backend design
Security, tests, integration, deployment and capstone delivery

prerequisite_guidance: Understand JavaScript fundamentals before advanced narrowing and generics; understand modules before project references; understand promises before API integration; and understand type contracts plus runtime validation before production API design.
